table.name: TLGNR_MATERIAL_PACKAGE_BS
table.description: Material packaging types distinguished by SAP in the Material Interface in Material Group: Packaging Materials

column.name: MATERIAL_PACKAGE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. S001=Bulk powder, S002=Bag, S003=Pallet (empty), S004=Silo, S005=Service, S006=Bulk dumped.

column.name: CAN_HAVE_STORAGE_LOCATION_FLAG
column.description: Indicates whether material has physical storage location (=enabled) or no (=disabled)

column.name: LOGON_PACKAGE_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_package_type_bs. Mapping to the stricter types of packages distinguished by Logon.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
